text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âOne day, with Loves Only You's debut 
race fast approaching...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph, taking pictures while moving is 
pretty tough after all... It turns out way 
too blurry.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No good, huh~! I thought it'd give it a 
dynamic feel, though.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In that case, as expected... will we be 
filming each person one by one for their 
respective parts?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah~. Ideally I'd love to do it in a 
single cut, but we can make it look great 
in editing."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about I take over the 
camera during the most exciting part...? 
That way, everyone can be in the shot 
together.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bouquet-chan. But if we're 
taking a photo together, I'd rather have 
all four of us in it♪ That would be way 
more lovely!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Love-chan! Look, your Trainer is over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer-kun, perfect timing♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer-chan, perfect timing♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, I was hoping you could help me 
shoot a little video, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, I was hoping you could help me 
shoot a little video, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Love-chan's debut race is coming up, 
right? So the four of us from our 
generation decided to shoot a video to 
celebrate it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Gran Alegria. I've heard she 
is an Umamusume with an extraordinary 
dedication to mile races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And by "classmates," she meant those who 
made their Twinkle Series debut in the 
very same year.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Umm... T-The "Classmate Happy Dance" video 
is really popular on UmaTok right now.
choice_data_list: I see. That's news to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Chrono Genesis. I've heard 
she's an Umamusume with a deep knowledge 
of racing history, and that she shares a 
room with Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I only just learned about it from everyone 
recently myself, but—it seemed so 
delightful. I thought it might make a 
memorable blossom for you, Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Curren Bouquetd'or. I've heard 
she loves flowers and is an Umamusume who 
always carries a gentle aura around her.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Basically, if you can just stand there 
holding the camera, that'd be plenty... 
would that be okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ Thanks, Trainer-kun♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ Thanks, Trainer-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping Loves Only You 
and the others film their video—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —That's our Gran-chan! Sharp as a tack!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's a celebration, after all! Today's 
intensity is dialed up to 120 miles!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-Is this alright...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think it'll be fine. Let's keep 
matching with Loves-san as our center—!

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Nailed it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you so much, everyone! This has 
become such a wonderful keepsake♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you! Let's make more 
memories like this again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, thanks for filming too♪ 
Thanks to you, we got some super luv-ly 
footage!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for taking the photos, 
Trainer-chan♪ We got some super lovely 
shots thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm cheering for you to finish your debut 
race without injury. ...Please stay safe 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna follow right after 
everyone and make my debut filled with 
love, so look forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If Loves-chan can run in her usual form, 
I'm sure the results will follow. ...Do 
your best.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hearing you say that gives me so 
much confidence, Chrono-chan♪ I'll make 
sure to bring our generation's performance 
to a grand finale!♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the four of them get along so 
harmoniously warmed my heart, but 
something in their conversation made me 
realize a certain truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That meant that aside from Loves Only You, 
the other three had already finished 
running their debut races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her friends must have been cheering her on 
for making her debut last. Feeling that I 
had to live up to it, I tightened my own 
focus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then came the day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally Loves-chan's debut race...! 
I-I'm getting so nervous!!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"First, I want her to have fun... and come 
back safely from her run."

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
“Wish I could've gone in person~!” “So 
excited!” “My stomach is about to explode” 
“Praying so hard” “Please let it be a good 
result” “You can do it!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Loves Only You seems calm right before 
the race. As for me, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. All ready to go. Looks like I 
can head out whenever."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft...! Ahaha...!! Trainer, you're 
making the craziest face!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft...! Ahaha...!! Trainer, you're 
making the craziest face!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Were you nervous? You were pouting with 
such a scowl, I'd never seen anything like 
it before.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪ Somehow, that took the tension 
right out of my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just a little. But I'm okay now. 
Thanks to you, Trainer, I was able to 
relax nicely. ♪
choice_data_list: I hope that's the case, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just a little. But I'm okay now. 
Thanks to you, Trainer, I was able to 
relax nicely. ♪
choice_data_list: I hope that's the case, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Trainer-kun? Have you 
calmed down yet?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"How about you, Trainer-chan? Are you calm 
now?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being asked that made me realize. The 
trembling that had been there just moments 
ago had completely vanished, as if it were 
all a lie.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Even now, your expression is 
super lovely♡
choice_data_list:
...First off, just go out there and have 
fun in your debut race.

...First off, just go out there and have 
fun in your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll have the time of my life and 
come back safe and sound♪ And then—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin here together. The proof of 
our love!
